from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, json, subprocess, sys
main = Path('/home/linhao/Toolchain/development/LogAnalysisSkill')
prefix = 'docs/clang-fix-campaign/'
stage = prefix + 'dev_memory/stage14_p49_terminal_batch/a0-evidence/part2/'
for kind in ('item3', 'item4'):
    for name in ('raw.json', 'output.json', 'context.json'):
        rel = stage + 'e1-' + kind + '/' + name
        content = (main / rel).read_bytes()
        committed = subprocess.check_output(['git', '-C', str(main), 'show', '27fb460:' + rel])
        assert content == committed, rel
        print(rel + ' sha256=' + hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest() + ' unchanged_from_27fb460=PASS')
    raw_path = main / stage / ('e1-' + kind) / 'raw.json'
    raw = json.loads(raw_path.read_bytes())
    claim_id = 'OBS-1.' + kind + ('-predicate' if kind == 'item3' else '-anchors')
    claim = json.loads((raw_path.parent / 'output.json').read_bytes())[claim_id]
    digest = hashlib.sha256(raw_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    assert any(e['path'] == str(raw_path) and e['sha256'] == digest for e in claim['evidence'])
    print(kind + ' prior_rules_context=' + json.dumps(raw['context'], ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True))
pins = {
    'predicates.json': '8271f1d000a73808f1fa9787b90e868dd99038098eab192b26372e4eeaf694f6',
